important_correction: The earlier signal 11 was not evidence of a CUDA rowtile crash. It was caused by running llama-results --check in a fresh directory without a baseline result.gguf; gguf_init_from_file failed and the tool dereferenced a null gguf context in gguf_get_n_kv.
binary_note: The validation used the v2 rowtile binary left in build-ds4-moe-stream-batch-on after the rejected source attempt. Source files had already been reverted, so this is diagnostic evidence for the attempted patch, not retained branch behavior.
